text:
olivia: quick heads-up — found a broken anchor when following the incident page to the oncall runbook. clicking the 'postmortem' link goes to a 404 (it points to #post-mortem but the heading is #postmortem).

doc-bot: 📢 docs-scan: detected 404 at /docs/runbooks/service-oncall.md#postmortem (scan timestamp 2026-03-18T09:12Z).

sam: saw that earlier in the day. looks like a hyphen vs no-hyphen mismatch — trivial but annoying.

jia: if it's just the anchor rename we can do a tiny sed PR and preview. example:```bash
sed -i "s/#post-mortem/#postmortem/g" docs/runbooks/service-oncall.md
```

mike: who is the owner for that runbook? CODEOWNERS lists @sam but he's deep in release tasks today.

olivia: pinging @sam — can you take or delegate? we should fix before the next oncall rotation.

sam: I can shepherd but won't be able to push a commit until ~14:00 PT. @tanvi — want this one? it's safe to do.

tanvi: I can take it now. will open a tiny branch fix/runbook-anchor and include the incident page link update so nothing points to the old anchor.

tanvi: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 — small sed replace + updated incident page link + preview.

jia: perfect — can someone do a quick CR? @mike or @olivia? just one approval and merge. :eyes:

mike: happy to review in ~30m. please add a changelog line: "fix: runbook anchor link (postmortem)" so release notes capture it.

olivia: also double-check any other pages linking to /runbooks/service-oncall.md#post-mortem (search shows 2 other references), if easy update them in the same PR.

tanvi: updated both references in the repo in the same commit. kept changes tiny and added a unit to the link-check job to catch this pattern.

doc-bot: deploy-preview status: success — preview URL: https://deploy-preview-4821--docs.redwood.ai. link-check passed.

sam: thanks — once @mike approves I'll merge. can we add a follow-up to add a fuzzier link-check rule to catch hyphen variations?

jia: will open DOCS ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DOCS-1234 with test suggestions (fuzzy anchor equivalence).

mike: reviewed, left one tiny wording nit on the incident page. posted suggestion. approving after nit is fixed.

tanvi: fixed nit and pushed force-update to the PR.

olivia: merging now. :shipit: thanks all for the quick turnaround — saved what would have been a flaky oncall flow.

sam: appreciate the quick pickup, @tanvi and @mike for review.

(threads like this are short but super helpful — small docs fixes unblock ops)
